purpose: Authored fictional messages for the ship finder's evaluation gate (profile relic.vessel-mentions.v1). Every message, ship name, identifier, port and event here is invented for this evaluation; none is real message text, and the IMO and MMSI numbers were made up (IMO numbers carry a valid check digit). Najaf is named only as a place that contains the letters of a ship word. Expected mentions are gold expectations, not model output, and do not by themselves show model quality. These cases never enter the model prompt.

definitions.all_replies_decoded: Every case has an HTTP 200 reply from the pinned profile that the ship finder decodes: every quote copied exactly from its message and every name inside its quote. One failure fails the gate.
definitions.recall_min: Expected vessels in positive cases matched by a returned vessel, divided by all expected vessels. Names compare without ship prefixes, punctuation or case; a vessel identified only by a number matches on that number.
definitions.precision_min: Returned vessels in positive cases that match an expected vessel, divided by all vessels returned in positive cases. A second listing of a vessel already matched counts against precision.
definitions.negative_vessels_max: Vessels returned for messages that name none (shipment, relationship, ins and outs, Najaf, a port or an airline named like a ship, a ship type with no name, a class, a company, aircraft).
definitions.identifier_errors_max: On matched vessels, any IMO, MMSI, hull number or call sign that differs from the expectation, is missing, or is returned when none is written for that vessel.
definitions.stated_attributes_min: Flags and vessel types the message states, returned as expected, divided by all stated flags and types of matched vessels.
definitions.latin_names_min: Matched vessels whose written name is in another script and whose returned name_latin is in Latin letters, divided by all such vessels. Spellings in each case's latin list are reported, not required.
